/bicep/bicep-first-words.svg.label: param: Declares an input: a value the file accepts.
output: Names information ARM can return after a deployment.
string: The value is text; keep quotes around a text literal.

/bicep/bicep-workspace.svg.label: main.bicep: The filename. .bicep tells the editor which language to use.
PS C:\Users\YourName\Documents\CloudSeam-Bicep>: A displayed PowerShell prompt; do not paste PS, the path or > as a command.
Ctrl+S: Saves the editor buffer to the file the local CLI reads.

/bicep/bicep-toolchain.svg.label: bicep build: Compiles the file and performs compiler/linter diagnostics.
--file .\main.bicep: Selects a file in the current folder.

/bicep/bicep-errors.svg.label: Diagnostic: A compiler message with a severity and source location.
Error: Prevents a valid template from being emitted.
Warning: A concern to review; it may not prevent compilation.

/bicep/bicep-inputs.svg.label: param environment: An input you can provide separately for each deployment.
var resourceName = 'app-${environment}': A derived value: its result changes when environment changes.
param, string, var, output: Language keywords stay spelled exactly this way; your identifiers and allowed input values can differ.

/bicep/bicep-types.svg.label: true / false: Boolean literals, without quotes.

/bicep/bicep-resource.svg.label: resource storage: Declares a resource and its Bicep symbolic name.
'Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts@2023-05-01': Provider/type and the API schema version. Use a documented supported version.
properties: Service settings: HTTPS only, minimum TLS and no anonymous blob access in this example.

/bicep/bicep-json.svg.label: "key": "value": JSON requires quoted property names and commas between properties.
outputs: Information the deployment can return; never output credentials.

/bicep/bicep-guards.svg.label: @allowed: Restricts a parameter to named choices.
@secure: Suppresses normal parameter-value logging/display in ARM; still obtain secrets through an approved secret workflow.

/bicep/bicep-dependencies.svg.label: nsg.id: A symbolic reference that expresses an implicit dependency.
dependsOn: An explicit resource dependency when a real ordering relationship cannot be expressed naturally.
existing: References an already present resource; it does not create that resource or check its live existence during local compilation.

/bicep/bicep-network.svg.label: source / destination: Who sends the traffic and where it goes.
priority: Lower numbers are evaluated before higher numbers for matching NSG rules.
NSG vs Entra group: Network packet rules versus identity membership; do not interchange their resource types.

/bicep/bicep-existing.svg.label: existing: Use a resource already managed elsewhere.
scope: The subscription/resource group where a name is resolved; this example uses the current resource-group scope.
.id: A resource identifier expression; constructing it locally does not contact Azure.

/bicep/bicep-loops.svg.label: for i in range(0, serverCount): Repeat for indices 0 through serverCount minus 1.
nics[i].id: Use the NIC at this VM’s index.
@maxValue(3): A training limit, not a guarantee that three VMs are affordable or available.

/bicep/bicep-server-settings.svg.label: SystemAssigned: Azure manages this VM identity’s lifecycle; RBAC permissions require separate approved assignments.
imageReference: Publisher, offer, SKU and version identify the OS image; verify availability in the chosen region.
managedDisk: The OS disk remains a billable resource after deployment; stopping a VM does not remove disks.

/bicep/bicep-software.svg.label: loadTextContent: Reads a local companion file at compile time.
base64: Encoding for customData, not encryption. Never include secrets.
Cloud-init vs VM extension: OS first-boot configuration versus an Azure extension resource; choose a supported mechanism and make retries safe.

/bicep/bicep-modules.svg.label: params: Values the parent passes to the child’s declared parameters.
network.outputs.subnetId: The module’s declared output, not a free-form field name.

/bicep/bicep-environments.svg.label: using: Selects the blueprint for a .bicepparam file.
Default: Used when an input is not overridden; not a permanent constant.
Environment inputs: Names, counts and approved regions may differ; keywords and the module contract stay stable.

/bicep/bicep-azure-checks.svg.label: validate: Ask ARM to validate this template at the selected scope; provider checks depend on permissions and CLI version.
what-if: Preview proposed changes; unresolved expressions and provider behavior can limit accuracy.
create: An actual deployment command, deliberately separate from this practice checker.

/bicep/bicep-capstone.svg.label: Independent input: A parameter you choose, such as serverCount.
Derived value: An expression built from inputs, such as a resource name.
Resource dependency: A relationship such as a VM needing its NIC; different from the input/derived-value distinction.

/bicep/bicep-handoff.svg.label: Idempotent intent: Repeatedly requesting the same state should not create duplicate named resources; guest scripts must also be safe to retry.
Incremental mode: Manages declared resources without treating omitted declarations as automatic deletion requests.
Cleanup: Review the exact disposable scope and costs; snapshots, disks and other retained items may continue billing.
